title_en: Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Comprehensively Strengthening Judicial Protection of Intellectual Property Rights
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Opinions on Comprehensively Strengthening Judicial Protection of Intellectual Property Rights

Fa Fa [2020] No. 11

Strengthening intellectual property protection is the most important element of improving the property rights protection system and also the greatest incentive to enhance China's economic competitiveness. Judicial protection of intellectual property rights is an important force in the intellectual property protection system and plays an irreplaceable key role. Comprehensively strengthening judicial protection of intellectual property rights is not only an objective need for China to comply with international rules and fulfill international commitments, but also an inherent requirement for China to promote high-quality economic development and build a new system of a higher-level open economy. It is necessary to fully recognize the significant importance of comprehensively strengthening judicial protection of intellectual property rights, accurately grasp the starting point and objective positioning of intellectual property judicial protection in serving the overall situation, and provide strong judicial services and guarantees for building an innovative country, building a modern socialist power, and modernizing the national governance system and governance capacity. The following opinions are hereby put forward regarding the judicial protection of intellectual property rights by the people's courts.

I. Overall Requirements

1. Adhere to the guidance of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, deeply implement the "Opinions on Several Issues Concerning Strengthening Reform and Innovation in the Field of Intellectual Property Trial" and the "Opinions on Strengthening Intellectual Property Protection" issued by the General Office of the CPC Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council, closely focus on the goal of "striving to make the people feel fairness and justice in every judicial case", persist in serving the overall situation, judicially serving the people, and fair justice, fully utilize judicial remedies and sanctions, improve intellectual property litigation procedures, perfect the intellectual property trial system and mechanism, effectively curb intellectual property illegal and criminal acts, comprehensively enhance the level of intellectual property judicial protection, accelerate the modernization of the intellectual property trial system and trial capacity, and provide strong judicial services and guarantees for implementing the innovation-driven development strategy and cultivating a stable, fair, transparent, and predictable business environment.

II. Based on the Characteristics of Various Types of Cases, Effectively Protect the Legitimate Rights and Interests of Right Holders

2. Strengthen protection of scientific and technological innovation achievements. Formulate judicial interpretations for patent grant and validation administrative cases, standardize patent examination practices, and promote the improvement of patent grant quality; strengthen the trial of intellectual property cases involving patents, new plant varieties, integrated circuit layout designs, computer software, etc., ensure that the scope and intensity of intellectual property protection are commensurate with the degree of technical contribution, promote scientific and technological progress and innovation, and fully leverage the supporting and driving role of science and technology in leading economic and social development. Strengthen research on judicial protection of pharmaceutical patents, stimulate innovation motivation in drug research and development, and promote the healthy development of the pharmaceutical industry.

3. Strengthen protection of commercial mark rights and interests. Comprehensively consider factors such as the degree of similarity of trademark marks, the degree of similarity of goods, the distinctiveness and popularity of the trademark seeking protection, and adjudicate trademark infringement cases and trademark grant and validation cases according to law to enhance the recognizability and distinguishability of trademark marks. Fully utilize legal rules, within the discretionary space granted by law, make interpretations that effectively regulate acts of malicious trademark registration applications, and promote the normalization and standardization of the trademark application and registration order. Strengthen protection of well-known trademarks, and based on well-known facts, appropriately alleviate the trademark owner's burden of proof regarding the trademark's well-known status. Strengthen protection of geographical indications, and properly handle conflicts of rights between geographical indications and ordinary trademarks according to law.

4. Strengthen protection of copyright and related rights. Based on the characteristics of different works, properly grasp the standard for determining the originality of works. Properly handle the relationship between the development of information network technology and the protection of copyright and related rights, take into overall consideration the interests of creators, disseminators, business operators, and the public, coordinate the relationships between incentivizing creation, promoting industrial development, and guaranteeing basic cultural rights and interests, and promote cultural innovation and the development of business formats. Properly adjudicate new types of cases such as disputes over the dissemination of sports events and e-sports according to law, and promote the standardized development of emerging business formats. Strengthen research on litigation models for copyright enforcement, balance the interests of all parties according to law, and prevent improper profit-making behavior.

5. Strengthen protection of trade secrets. Correctly grasp the boundary between civil disputes over trade secret infringement and criminal offenses. Reasonably apply the rules of burden of proof in civil litigation, and appropriately alleviate the burden of enforcement on right holders according to law. Improve the standards for determining criminal acts of trade secret infringement, standardize the scope and methods of calculating significant losses, and reasonable remediation costs incurred to mitigate commercial damage or re-secure security may serve as a basis for determining "causing significant losses" or "causing particularly serious consequences" in criminal cases. Strengthen protection of trade secrets such as confidential business information, ensure fair competition among enterprises and reasonable flow of talent, and promote scientific and technological innovation.

6. Improve the rules for determining infringement on e-commerce platforms. Strengthen the fight against and remediation of online intellectual property infringement, effectively respond to the rights enforcement demands of right holders on e-commerce platforms. Improve e-commerce platform governance rules including the "notice-takedown" mechanism, and smooth the channels for right holders to enforce rights online. Properly adjudicate online intellectual property infringement disputes and unfair competition disputes arising from malicious complaints. While exempting the good-faith sender of erroneous takedown notices from liability according to law, urge and guide e-commerce platforms to actively fulfill their statutory obligations, and promote the healthy development of e-commerce, also pursue the legal liability of persons who abuse rights or file malicious complaints, and reasonably balance the interests of all parties.

7. Actively promote the transfer and application of intellectual achievements. Properly adjudicate disputes arising from the transfer, transformation, and application of intellectual achievements according to law, adhere to the spirit of respecting the autonomy of the parties and reducing transaction costs, reasonably define the legal relationships, benefit distribution, and liability allocation at each stage from creation to application of intellectual achievements, accurately determine service inventions versus non-service inventions according to law, effectively protect the property rights of service inventors, and safeguard the legitimate rights and interests of R&D personnel to receive bonuses and remuneration for patent implementation.

8. Punish intellectual property criminal acts according to law. Severely crack down on criminal acts infringing intellectual property rights, further advance the reform of the criminal procedure system centered on trials, effectively implement the requirements of substantive court trials, improve the appraisal procedures, standardize the system for expert witnesses to testify in court and the system of leniency for guilty pleas and acceptance of punishment. Accurately grasp the boundary between criminal legal relations and civil legal relations in intellectual property, strengthen the application of fines, and for criminal acts such as obtaining trade secrets through illegal means like theft, threats, or inducements, and other acts with significant social harm, impose stricter and heavier punishments according to law, effectively exert the function of criminal punishment in punishing and deterring intellectual property crimes.

9. Equally protect the legitimate rights of Chinese and foreign entities. Properly adjudicate foreign-related intellectual property disputes arising from international trade, foreign investment, etc., according to law, adhere to equal protection according to law, appropriately simplify notarization and certification procedures, further improve a fair, efficient, and authoritative dispute resolution mechanism, and enhance the international influence and credibility of intellectual property justice.

III. Focus on Solving Outstanding Issues to Enhance the Actual Effect of Judicial Protection

10. Effectively reduce the cost of intellectual property enforcement. Formulate judicial interpretations on evidence in intellectual property civil litigation, improve the rules on the distribution of burden of proof, the system for excluding evidence obstruction, and the system for witnesses to testify in court, broaden the channels for collecting electronic data evidence, accurately grasp the application of electronic data rules, and support the parties' requests for evidence preservation and investigation and evidence collection according to law, reducing the burden of proof on the parties.

11. Vigorously shorten the intellectual property litigation cycle. Actively carry out pilot work on the separation of complicated and simple cases, promoting the separation of complicated and simple cases, the separation of major and minor issues, and the differentiation of fast and slow tracks in case handling. Deepen the reform of intellectual property adjudication methods, achieve seamless connection between civil and administrative procedures for patents and trademarks, and prevent circular litigation. Strictly apply the review standards for commissioning appraisals, suspension of proceedings, and remand for retrial according to law, reducing unnecessary time consumption. Support applications for intellectual property behavior preservation according to law, creating conditions for the timely enforcement of judgments.

12. Effectively increase the amount of damages for infringement. Fully utilize relevant data from industry and commerce tax departments, third-party commercial platforms, the infringer's website or listing documents, and industry average profit rates to determine the profits obtained from infringement according to law. Comprehensively consider factors such as the market value of the intellectual property, the subjective fault of the infringer, and the duration, scope of impact, and severity of consequences of the infringement, and reasonably determine the amount of statutory damages. For acts of intellectual property infringement with serious circumstances, determine the amount of damages at a higher level according to law, and confiscate and destroy counterfeit or pirated goods and materials and tools primarily used for infringement according to law, effectively preventing the recurrence of acts infringing intellectual property rights.

13. Prevent dishonest litigation acts according to law. Properly adjudicate disputes over liability for damages caused by malicious filing of intellectual property lawsuits, and support claims for damages including reasonable expenses such as attorney fees according to law. Strengthen the guiding rules for jurisdiction disputes in intellectual property, and regulate acts that maliciously delay litigation by artificially creating jurisdictional connecting points or abusing objections to jurisdiction. Study the inclusion of dishonest litigation actors who violate court orders, forge evidence, or engage in malicious litigation into the national credit information system.

14. Effectively enforce intellectual property judicial judgments. In light of the characteristics of intellectual property cases, comprehensively optimize the enforcement jurisdictional rules for intellectual property cases. Study and improve the working mechanisms for behavior preservation and behavior enforcement. Formulate implementation plans and work guidelines for the enforcement of intellectual property judgments, fully utilize means such as information-based network search and control and joint credit sanctions for dishonesty to strengthen the enforcement of judgments, ensuring that intellectual property judgments are effectively enforced.

IV. Strengthen Institutional Mechanism Construction to Improve Overall Effectiveness of Judicial Protection

15. Improve the specialized trial system for intellectual property. Based on the current status, rules, and trends of intellectual property trials, study and improve the establishment of specialized courts, optimize the layout of competent courts for intellectual property cases, improve the appeal mechanism for intellectual property cases, unify trial standards, and achieve specialization of intellectual property case adjudication, concentration of jurisdiction, procedural aggregation, and professionalization of personnel.

16. Deeply implement the "Three-in-One" trial mechanism. Establish and improve the case jurisdiction system and coordination mechanism suitable for the "Three-in-One" trial mechanism for civil, administrative, and criminal intellectual property proceedings, and improve the overall effectiveness of intellectual property judicial protection. Grasp the differences in the standards of proof across different proceedings, treat the res judicata of judgments in prior related cases according to law, and properly handle cross-cutting intellectual property criminal, administrative, and civil cases.

17. Continuously improve the mechanism for ascertaining technical facts. Appropriately expand the sources of technical investigators, enrich the national court technical investigator talent pool, and establish and improve a technical investigator talent sharing mechanism. Build a technical fact ascertainment mechanism involving technical investigation officers, technical consulting experts, technical appraisers, and expert assistants participating in litigation activities, and enhance the neutrality, objectivity, and scientific nature of technical fact ascertainment.

18. Strengthen the role of intellectual property case guidance. Establish a multi-faceted intellectual property case guidance system consisting of guiding cases, gazette cases, and typical cases of the Supreme People's Court, fully leverage the guiding role of typical cases in judicial adjudication, and promote the uniformity of adjudication rules.

19. Rely on the four major platforms to implement trial openness. Fully utilize the four major platforms of trial process disclosure, court hearing activity disclosure, judgment document disclosure, and enforcement information disclosure to maximize the protection of the rights to know, participate, and supervise of the parties and the public. Enrich the publicity content of "4.26" World Intellectual Property Day, expand the effect of external publicity, and enhance the understanding, recognition, respect, and trust of all sectors of society in intellectual property judicial protection.

20. Strengthen international exchanges and cooperation in intellectual property. Actively participate in the construction of a multilateral system for intellectual property protection, and jointly promote the creation of relevant new international rules. Strengthen exchanges and cooperation with foreign judicial, research, and practical institutions as well as international intellectual property organizations, actively carry out intellectual property seminars and exchange activities with international influence, increase the translation and promotion of Chinese intellectual property judgment documents, and expand the international influence of Chinese intellectual property justice.

V. Strengthen Communication and Coordination to Form a Joint Force for Intellectual Property Protection

21. Improve and perfect the多元化 dispute resolution mechanism. Support the multi-channel resolution of intellectual property disputes, carry out pilot judicial confirmation of mediation agreements for intellectual property disputes, fully leverage the leading and promoting role of the judiciary in the construction of a多元化 dispute resolution mechanism, and enhance the overall efficiency of dispute resolution.

22. Optimize the coordination mechanism for intellectual property protection. Strengthen communication and coordination with public security and procuratorial organs in intellectual property judicial proceedings, strengthen the connection with administrative enforcement procedures of administrative authorities such as intellectual property, market regulation, copyright, customs, and agriculture, and promote the formation of a joint force for intellectual property protection.

23. Establish an information communication, coordination, and sharing mechanism. Establish and improve a data exchange mechanism with intellectual property administrative authorities, normalize the use of intellectual property big data analysis tools, and improve the level of comprehensive research, judgment, and decision-making.

VI. Strengthen Trial Infrastructure Construction to Effectively Support Intellectual Property Judicial Protection Work

24. Strengthen the construction of the intellectual property trial team. Improve the secondment and exchange mechanism for full-time judges, actively promote the selection of outstanding judge assistants to take temporary positions in lower courts, select outstanding judges to serve in higher courts, and realize the exchange and sharing of intellectual property talent. Strengthen professional training for judicial personnel in intellectual property. Strengthen the allocation of judicial support personnel, and build a professional trial team with a complete configuration of "judges, assistants, and clerks" and effective supplementation by technical investigation officers.

25. Strengthen the infrastructure construction of specialized courts and tribunals. Strengthen the construction of the Intellectual Property Tribunal of the Supreme People's Court and various intellectual property courts and tribunals nationwide, strengthen the guarantee of specialized trial institutions in terms of institutional setup, personnel allocation, office space, and activity funds, and provide solid human and material foundations for intellectual property judicial protection.

26. Strengthen the informatization construction of intellectual property trials. Strengthen the modernization and intelligentization of intellectual property judicial equipment, actively promote the construction of cross-regional remote litigation platforms for intellectual property. Vigorously promote the popularization and application of information technologies such as online case filing, online evidence exchange, electronic service, online court hearings, intelligent speech recognition, electronic archiving, and mobile micro-courts, support the online handling of the entire trial process, and improve the convenience, efficiency, and transparency of judicial resolution of intellectual property disputes. Strengthen the in-depth application of electronic files, judgment documents, trial information, etc., and fully utilize judicial big data to provide intelligent services and precise decision-making.

April 15, 2020
